design: 13 items per tier over 8 tiers = 104; tiers processed in ascending tier name, each tier's candidates sorted by sample_id before sampling, so the draw is deterministic and pool-order independent. Equal per-tier counts, so there is no remainder allocation rule.
exposure: EXPOSED. Every item is a member of the frozen 400-item discovery split already read by the A0 baseline, P-EMB-2 and the S2/S2b/S2c probes. Campaign plan section 3.3: this tier's numbers are SECONDARY readings and are never the campaign claim.
id_field_convention: sample_id (tier:NNNNNN) is what the loader and every flight uses; key (audio2tool:tier:NNNNNN) is the split_identity_hash basis only; run_identity_hash is the load-split convention over audio2tool/tier:NNNNNN. Set comparisons against a flown population MUST use sample_id.
purpose: Audio2Tool generality campaign stage G1 -- mechanics and first signal under the section 8.1 derived serving geometry.
